user.title: Connect ProstoCAM
user.description: In the ProstoCAM web account open Smart home, choose Home Assistant and press Connect. Enter the pairing code shown there; it is valid for 10 minutes.

data_description.code: 8 letters and digits, for example ABCD-1234.
data_description.server: Change only if your ProstoCAM provider gave you another address.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect ProstoCAM
reauth_confirm.description: ProstoCAM no longer accepts this Home Assistant. In the web account open Smart home, Home Assistant, press Reconnect and enter the new pairing code. Sensors and camera links stay as they are.

data_description.code: 8 letters and digits, for example ABCD-1234.

reconfigure.title: Change the ProstoCAM connection
reconfigure.description: Move this connection to another ProstoCAM server or pair it again. In the ProstoCAM web account open Smart home, Home Assistant, press Reconnect and enter the new pairing code. Sensors, cameras and automations stay as they are.

data_description.code: 8 letters and digits, for example ABCD-1234.
data_description.server: The address of the ProstoCAM server; keep it unless your provider gave you another one.

error.invalid_code: The code is wrong or expired. Get a new code in the ProstoCAM web account.
error.invalid_server: This is not a web address.
error.already_connected: Home Assistant of this account is already connected with a rest_command automation. Disconnect it in the ProstoCAM web account first.
error.client_outdated: ProstoCAM needs a newer version of this integration. Update it in HACS and restart Home Assistant.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.not_available: Home Assistant connections are not switched on for this ProstoCAM server yet. Contact your ProstoCAM provider.
error.cannot_connect: The ProstoCAM server can not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This ProstoCAM connection is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: The code belongs to another ProstoCAM connection. Use the Reconnect button of this connection.

init.title: What to share with ProstoCAM
init.description: Only entities of these types appear in the ProstoCAM web account. Changes are sent only for entities you switch on there.

data.arming_sync: Sync with the Home Assistant alarm panel

data_description.domains: Alarm panels report arming and disarming.
data_description.device_classes: Binary sensors of other classes (battery, connectivity and so on) are never sent.
data_description.arming_sync: Off by default. When on, arming or disarming ProstoCAM changes the chosen panel and the other way round. Needs the "arming" access in the ProstoCAM web account.
data_description.arming_sync_entity: The panel that follows ProstoCAM (not the ProstoCAM panel itself).

error.no_domains: Choose at least one entity type.
error.sync_entity_required: Choose the alarm panel to sync with.
error.sync_entity_own: This is the ProstoCAM panel itself; choose a panel of another integration.

client_outdated.title: Update the ProstoCAM integration
client_outdated.description: The ProstoCAM server no longer accepts this version of the integration, so sensor events are not delivered. Update ProstoCAM in HACS and restart Home Assistant; events that waited in the queue will be sent.

missing_access.title: Give Home Assistant access to ProstoCAM
missing_access.description:
The ProstoCAM connection of this Home Assistant has no access to: {scopes}. Home Assistant shows only what the subscriber allowed: cameras:read — cameras and snapshots, events:read — alarms and frames of events, live:read — live video, archive:read — clips and the archive in Media, arming:write — the ProstoCAM arming as an alarm panel, actions:write — test alarm, AI check, do not disturb and deterrence buttons, account:read — balance, tariff and AI credits.

In the ProstoCAM web account open Smart Home → Home Assistant → "What Home Assistant will see", tick what it may see and press "Save access". No new code is needed: Home Assistant picks the change up within a minute. Everyone with access to your Home Assistant can use what you allow.

account_stage.title: ProstoCAM account is {stage}
account_stage.description: ProstoCAM limits this account because of an unpaid balance ({stage}): recordings, alarms or live video may stop. Top up the balance in the ProstoCAM web account; this message goes away by itself within 15 minutes after the payment.

scope_missing.message: ProstoCAM does not allow this to Home Assistant: {message}. Give the access in the ProstoCAM web account (Smart Home → Home Assistant).

token_invalid.message: ProstoCAM no longer accepts this Home Assistant; reconnect it with a new code.

arming_not_ready.message: ProstoCAM is not ready to arm: {cameras}. Fix the cameras or use the action "Arm ProstoCAM anyway".

arming_conflict.message: The ProstoCAM arming has just been changed elsewhere; Home Assistant took the new state. Try again if it is still needed.

no_event.message: This camera has had no alarm since Home Assistant started; there is nothing to check.

ai_confirm.message: {message}. Call the action with "Spend a credit" switched on.

ai_press_again.message: {message}. Press the button again within {seconds} s to confirm.

entry_not_loaded.message: This ProstoCAM connection is not loaded.

no_access.message: ProstoCAM does not allow this to Home Assistant ({scope}). Give the access in the ProstoCAM web account (Smart Home → Home Assistant).

needs_protocol_4.message: The ProstoCAM server does not support this yet (it needs protocol 4). Try again after the server is updated.

export_failed.message: ProstoCAM could not prepare the clip. Order it again; if it happens again, the reason code is in the diagnostics of the integration.

export_no_recording.message: There is no recording for this time: the camera recorded nothing. Retrying will not help — choose a time that has a recording.

export_no_recording_nearest.message: There is no recording for this time — the nearest recording: {nearest}.

export_gaps.message: There is no continuous recording in this range: it is empty or has gaps. Order a shorter clip or another time.

export_recording_gone.message: The recording of this range disappeared while the clip was being prepared (for example, removed by the retention period).

export_damaged.message: The recording of this range is damaged and can not be read. Choose a neighbouring range.

export_encoding_changed.message: The camera changed its codec or resolution in the middle of this range. Order the time before and after the change separately.

export_cancelled.message: The clip was not prepared: the export was cancelled.

export_cannot_assemble.message: ProstoCAM can not assemble this clip; retrying will not help. Please tell the ProstoCAM support.

export_retry.message: ProstoCAM failed while assembling the clip; the recording itself is intact. Order it again.

ai_credits_insufficient.message: Not enough AI credits for this check. Top up the credits in the ProstoCAM web account.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests to ProstoCAM. Try again in a minute.

camera_not_found.message: ProstoCAM does not know this camera or it is not chosen for Home Assistant (web account → Smart Home → Home Assistant).

event_not_found.message: ProstoCAM has no such event of this camera.

export_not_found.message: ProstoCAM no longer has this export; order the clip again.

account_inactive.message: The ProstoCAM account is suspended; video and recordings come back after payment.

arming_readiness_unknown.message: ProstoCAM can not tell yet whether the cameras are ready for arming. Try again in a minute.

already_in_progress.message: ProstoCAM is already doing the same request; wait for its result.

server_busy.message: ProstoCAM can not do this right now. Try again in a few minutes.

no_recording.message: There is no recording for this time.

bridge_disabled.message: Home Assistant is switched off in the ProstoCAM web account (Smart Home → Home Assistant).

invalid_request.message: ProstoCAM did not accept the request: {message}

refused_unknown.message: ProstoCAM refused the request. The reason code is in the diagnostics of the integration.

export_in_future.message: The clip must end in the past: choose an earlier start or a shorter duration.

mute.name: Do not disturb
mute.description: Mutes the alarms of a ProstoCAM camera on every channel for a while (alarms are still written to the feed).

test_alarm.name: Test alarm
test_alarm.description: Sends a test alarm of a ProstoCAM camera through every channel of the subscriber (feed, push, Telegram, Home Assistant).

verify_ai.name: Check with AI
verify_ai.description: Asks the ProstoCAM AI to check an event over the series of its frames. Spends an AI credit only with "Spend a credit" on; off — the reply names the price.

device_id.name: Camera
device_id.description: The last alarm of this ProstoCAM camera is checked.

event_id.name: Event
event_id.description: Number of the event (attribute event_id of the alarm); instead of the camera.

config_entry_id.name: Connection
config_entry_id.description: With an event number: the ProstoCAM connection, when there are several.

arm_anyway.name: Arm ProstoCAM anyway
arm_anyway.description: Arms ProstoCAM although some cameras are not ready, naming each of them (as "Arm anyway" in the web account).

config_entry_id.name: Connection
config_entry_id.description: The ProstoCAM connection, when there are several.

ask_archive.name: Ask the archive
ask_archive.description: Searches the recordings of ProstoCAM cameras by a question in plain words ("when did someone come to the gate today?") and answers with a short phrase and the events found, with their frames and clips. Spends no AI credits.

question.name: Question
question.description: In Ukrainian, Russian, English or Bulgarian; up to 300 characters.

config_entry_id.name: Connection
config_entry_id.description: The ProstoCAM connection, when there are several.

export_clip.name: Export a clip
export_clip.description: Cuts a clip of the archive of a ProstoCAM camera (as "Export" in the web account) and returns a short-lived download link with its SHA-256. The clip also appears in Media.

start.name: Start
start.description: The start of the clip, in the time zone of Home Assistant.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: 1…600 seconds; the clip must end in the past.

wait.name: Wait for the file
wait.description: Wait until the file is ready (up to 5 minutes); off — return the job at once, the event prostocam_export_ready is not sent then.
